_comment: Copy to principals.json, which is git-ignored. Only key hashes belong here, never keys.
Mint a key and its hash:  KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32); echo $KEY; printf %s $KEY | sha256sum
Hand the key to the person over a channel you trust, and keep only the hash.
To revoke, set revoked_at. Do not delete the record: the audit trail needs it.
emails are the verified Google addresses that may sign in as this principal.
A principal with no emails cannot use the web interface, only its API keys.
One address belongs to exactly one principal; a duplicate fails at startup.
